title: Raymond Blanc's roasted chicken
ahead: Take the chicken and the butter out of the fridge 1 h ahead.

steps.text: Spread the wing pieces in a roasting pan as a bed for {chicken}. Brush the bird all over with {butter} and season with salt and pepper.
Roast in the hot oven to colour the bird.
Baste with the hot fat and juices. Lower the oven to 130 °C fan and roast, basting now and then, until golden brown all over and the juices run clear when you pierce the thigh.
Move the chicken to a serving dish. Turn the oven off and put the dish back in, door ajar, to rest.
Meanwhile, pour the excess fat out of the roasting pan. Set it over high heat, add {water} and scrape up the caramelised bits.
Pour the liquid and the wing pieces into a small pan. Simmer, skimming off the fat as it rises.
Strain the jus and adjust the seasoning.
Carve the chicken. Serve with the jus alongside.
